text.Defense System:
How to play ==
At any time during your turn, gain 2 Combat. If you have another Machine Cult card in play, gain another 2 Combat. Defense System is an outpost with a defense of 5.
 Strategy ==
Like Integration Port, the main purpose of this outpost is often to protect other bases and HQ. The primary 2 Combat is rather meager, but when coupled with another Machine Cult card this gets bumped up to a reasonable 4. Still not that much, but certainly decent considering the cost and the fact that it is more difficult to take out than other bases of this cost. Ideally you want to have this card in play together with an Integration Port or another Defense System: this provides a strong first line of both attack and defense.
